_comment: Ownership manifest for the architecture-review remediation team.
Frozen before fan-out; the sole arbiter afterwards. A unit id here is spawned
as a teammate `name`, so a teammate spawned under any other name owns nothing
and every write it attempts is denied.

_verify_why: `make verify` runs go build, go test, golangci-lint and static validation of
the kustomize overlays, Crossplane compositions and CI workflows. Green at
baseline in 12s on commit b5f8ce5. Everything in it runs WITHOUT cluster or
cloud credentials, so it proves manifests are well-formed -- never that they
are correct against a live API. Findings 11 and 12 in particular cannot be
verified beyond parse-level here; see policy.unverifiable_scope.
_unverifiable_scope: No AWS credentials, no live cluster, and neither terraform nor helm is
installed on this machine. Any change whose correctness depends on the AWS
or Kubernetes API must be labelled UNVERIFIED in the completion report, with
the static check that WAS run named explicitly. Do not report such a change
as fixed. This is the evidence standard, not a formality: finding 12 is a
composition that silently emits nothing, which is exactly the failure mode a

_shared_surfaces_why: Owned by nobody, changed only through an ADR that lists the path under
`affects:`. Makefile is listed because it now contains the verify gate itself,
so a unit cannot quietly weaken the thing that guarantees nothing is marked
done on red. docs/reviews/** is listed so four units do not contend for the
finding list; the lead marks findings resolved as units report.

clauses.E1: the change alters a published contract
clauses.E3: the change touches a migration or an auth boundary
clauses.E4: the change requires a decision no ADR covers and two or more units depend on it
clauses.E5: the same test has failed three times

unit-manifests.description: Kubernetes deployment manifests and Kargo promotion config. Unblocks hermes-send at the NetworkPolicy layer, opens OTel egress, and makes the migration Job re-runnable across promotions.

meta.verifiable: kustomize build only -- `kubectl kustomize` proves the overlays render, not that a NetworkPolicy admits the traffic it names or that ArgoCD accepts the Job. Label admission behaviour UNVERIFIED.
meta.note: Finding 8 is wider than the NetworkPolicy: hermes-send is also absent from the replicas patch, resources patch, HPA set, PDB set and anti-affinity patch, so it stays at replicas 1 in production. The Kargo health check gap is finding 35 and is OUT of scope -- do not fix it, and do not let it grow this unit.

unit-delivery.description: Delivery worker error handling. Failures are currently acked as success, so the retry/backoff and DLQ machinery in internal/messaging is dead code for all three workers.

meta.verifiable: fully -- this is the one unit whose fix is provable locally. Go tests must demonstrate a provider error reaching the DLQ rather than being acked, and the mutation check applies: break the retry path on purpose and name the test that goes red.
meta.note: The DLQ stream and internal/messaging retry code already exist; this is about routing to them, not building them. Adding a retry dependency is E2 -- escalate rather than adding to go.mod.

unit-crossplane.description: Crossplane compositions and XRDs. The secrets bundle creates an empty Secrets Manager secret and emits no connectionDetails, so every ExternalSecret key fails to resolve.

meta.verifiable: NO -- parse-level only. There is no AWS account, no live Crossplane, and terraform is not installed. Every change from this unit ships UNVERIFIED with the YAML validation named as the only evidence.
meta.note: The XRD declares seven connection keys including database_url and redis_url, and the required databaseSecretRef/cacheSecretRef inputs are never referenced. Read xrds/hermes-secrets.yaml before touching the composition -- the contract is there, not in the composition.

unit-supply-chain.description: CI gating and build-toolchain pinning. Nothing currently compares the generated SDKs against the specs they come from, which is how finding 43 drifted a full rename deep while every check stayed green.

meta.verifiable: partly -- workflow YAML parses locally and the pnpm fix is testable, but whether the job passes on GitHub's runners cannot be proven here. actionlint is not installed.
meta.note: Three parts: a drift gate running `make sdk-generate && git diff --exit-code sdks/`, the undocumented JVM/Maven/.NET prerequisites in CONTRIBUTING.md, and pinning pnpm plus an onlyBuiltDependencies allowlist so `make sdk-ts-generate` stops failing outright on pnpm 11. Adding a make target is a Makefile change -- that is a shared surface, so escalate.

_worktrees_why: Worktree directory name -> unit id, recorded by the lead at spawn time.
